in_greek.name: Σκιππίη
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word σκιπτόμαι (skipto) meaning 'to scold' or 'to rebuke'. The name Skippie could be a derivative of this name, meaning 'rebuke' or 'scold'.

in_latin.name: Scripia
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'scriptus' meaning 'written'. The name Skippie could be derived from this root, meaning 'one who writes' or 'scribe'.
